summary: Records the operator's Spec Amendment for T-20260729T065622764296Z-48021407, authored by the operator at https://github.com/mizutani-140/shiki/pull/226#issuecomment-5142088774 (mizutani-140, 2026-07-31T10:52:57Z). This ledger entry REFERENCES that decision; it does not assert it. The amendment defers acceptance criterion 5 and the scope clause promoting cca_checklist_profile to a required field. Reason, as stated by the operator: satisfying them requires backfilling ~98 pre-existing task files, and MergeGate's enforce_untrusted_shiki_mutations blocks a task PR from touching any task file but its own, independently of declared locks, so the criterion is undeliverable through the normal task-PR path. The task's substantive capability - refusing a self-contradictory CCA verdict, enforcing checklist-profile coverage when a profile is declared, and binding task.schema.json's required set to validate_shiki.TASK_REQUIRED - is delivered and verified unchanged. The task file therefore no longer matches its frozen plan definition on scope and acceptance_checks; that divergence IS this amendment. Mechanism note: this write reaches main through a path MergeGate does not currently guard - a normal task PR may modify its own task file's governance fields. Closing that gap is the next task (ADR 0015 Contract immutability, never implemented outside contract/goal_reconcile/post_merge_reconcile). No supported delivery mode for a Spec Amendment exists today; that is a recorded finding. An earlier revision of this entry asserted the approval itself and was correctly rejected by CCA-12 as a runtime-authored approval record.
